title: Comment “Discount” and I’ll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask ChatGPT to find
description: Comment “Discount” and I’ll send you all the prompts 👇 What happens when you ask ChatGPT to find you discount codes for anything you’re about to buy online? I tried this and now I save 20% on everything I buy. Here’s how: Prompt 1: Go to ChatGPT, select Work at the top, paste in the link to whatever you’re about to buy, and say: “Find me every working discount code, coupon, and promo for this exact product right now.” ChatGPT pulls every code it can find for that store. Prompt 2 (the trick): Stay in the same chat and say: “Now open your browser and go test every single one of those discount codes on the checkout page and tell me exactly which one saves the most.” ChatGPT opens its own browser, runs every single code through checkout for you, and comes back with the ones that actually work and save you the most money. Comment “Discount” and I’ll send you all these prompts plus more. #chatgpt #ai #chatgptprompts #savemoney #aitools
